{{Quote|Ussto cleverly manipulated fourteen Sertar markets (without one slave rebellion!), restructured forty-three planetary economies and still found time to practice his favorite recreational pastime&mdash;Norky Chips.|Letter signed by the [[Lingsnots]]|<ref name="MAGL">''[[Monsters and Aliens from George Lucas]]''</ref>}}
The '''Sertar Market Rebellions''' were a series of rebellions, in which people fought against injustice. They were commemorated with a memorial in the [[Crypt of Martyrs]], on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Lorrd/Legends|Lorrd]].<ref name="DSPL">{{Hyperspace|url=hyperspace/fiction/feature20090531/index.html?page=1|text=Death in the Slave Pits of Lorrd: A Hyperspace Exclusive|int=Death in the Slave Pits of Lorrd}}</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
{{Quote|The Sertar slave market rebellions are easily the most obscure reference in the article, having only been mentioned in a throwaway line in ''Monsters and Aliens From George Lucas''.|[[Adrick Tolliver]]|<ref name="Endnotes">{{Blog|taloncard|12|Endnotes for "Death in the Slave Pits of Lorrd"}}</ref>}}
